10219|572db4df.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
10219|572db4df.text: May Elune walk with you, $c.  The Temple of the Moon has come to help the troubled citizens of Auberdine.

10897|c5ceacbe.name: Sindrayl
10897|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

11026|766a64ec.name: Sprite Jumpsprocket
11026|766a64ec.text: Ah, what a beautiful day to blow something up!

11799|992f6a78.name: Tajarri
11799|992f6a78.text:
The Shrine of Remulos is a sacred place for us in the Cenarion Circle here in Moonglade... so please conduct yourself in a manner befitting a visitor.

A visitor who doesn't want my scimitar buried in them, that is.

11800|2051e10a.name: Silva Fil'naveth
11800|2051e10a.text: Would you like a flight to Rut'theran Village, courtesy of the Cenarion Circle?

11802|ef8483c2.name: Dendrite Starblaze
11802|ef8483c2.text:
Greetings, $c.  You are welcome in Nighthaven, as well as all of Moonglade.  The Cenarion Circle welcomes all beings who respect the authority and command of nature.

While you are here, please be sure to preserve the balance in all things.  Disturbances are not welcome here, and our wardens are trained to cease all hostilities without question.

11865|7022eed4.name: Buliwyf Stonehand
11865|7022eed4.text: Ye want to be trained in the use of a weapon, do ye?  Well don't stand there slack-jawed, speak up laddie!

1239|c86281a7.name: First Mate Fitzsimmons
1239|c86281a7.text: If you're willing to endure tales that will shiver your timbers and sog your skivvies, then get yourself a drink and sit for a spell...

1244|245cbd71.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
1244|245cbd71.text:
The roots and ferns speak well of you, small one. Although I have many names, I answer to few. But you may call me Rethiel.

And you must harken... for these lands weep from festered wounds, and I would charge you to heal them.

1247|b63e4e81.name: Innkeeper Belm
1247|b63e4e81.text: Fill yer tankard and pull up a chair. We've stories to tell and kegs to empty.

1265|a0959aba.name: Rudra Amberstill
1265|a0959aba.text: Welcome to the Amberstill Corral.  If you're interested in purchasing a mount, my husband Veron will be more than happy to help you choose just the right beast.  If you're looking for adventure, well we sure could use some help around here. . .

1287|ed056522.name: Marda Weller
1287|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1287|fe52f4ea.name: Marda Weller
1287|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1289|ed056522.name: Gunther Weller
1289|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

12997|6ce695f2.name: Monty
12997|6ce695f2.text: Monty be me name an' rats be me game.

13018|0a2f0661.name: Nipsy
13018|0a2f0661.text: You'll find no finer rat kabob this side of Khaz Modan!

1303|e86e31c2.name: Felicia Gump
1303|e86e31c2.text: We are the only supplier of healthy flowers in all of Stormwind. We provide beautiful blooms for any occasion.

13084|554a4659.name: Bixi Wobblebonk
13084|554a4659.text: Well hi there!  Are you here to learn the proper technique of a new weapon?

1325|e69bef2b.name: Jasper Fel
1325|e69bef2b.text: Speak quietly and with great care, the wrong word in these parts could get your throat cut. Now, what is it you need from me?

1340|76d04af9.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
1340|76d04af9.text:
Welcome to Thelsamar, your home away from home in Loch Modan!

Thelsamar is a nice place, but it's not all beer and salted meat for those who answer the call to duty!  If you're willing to face danger in the name of the Alliance, then read the poster outside the Thelsamar branch of the Explorers' League.

1343|5751dde2.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
1343|5751dde2.text:
Well, if it isn't a young, bristling $c, no doubt drawn here by talk of my exploits in fields of battle!

No time for stories now, for there are great, important deeds that need doing!  So if you're looking for glory, then luck shines on you today...

1355|0c543544.name: Cook Ghilm
1355|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

1374|61386298.name: Rejold Barleybrew
1374|61386298.text:
Curse that Brewers' League!  They have access to all the best ingredients, while we're stuck here grubbing for grain and hops!

I really would like to give them some bitter tasting justice...

1416|c14f3f06.name: Grimand Elmore
1416|c14f3f06.text:
If you've come looking for the finest craftsmanship on this or any other continent in the world, then you've come to the right place!

Grimand Elmore, at your service!

1464|b63e4e81.name: Innkeeper Helbrek
1464|b63e4e81.text: Fill yer tankard and pull up a chair. We've stories to tell and kegs to empty.

1466|8a39834c.name: Gretta Finespindle
1466|8a39834c.text: This hide isn't ready to work with yet. I wish it didn't take so long to make leather. There has to be some way to cut down on all this waiting. It can't be good for my health, you know?

1466|f7f23ddc.name: Gretta Finespindle
1466|f7f23ddc.text: Oh, goody, something else to do while I wait! You're a real life-saver, $N!

1571|c5ceacbe.name: Shellei Brondir
1571|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1572|04178a2e.name: Thorgrum Borrelson
1572|04178a2e.text: Mark my words!  You won't find faster gryphons anywhere in the Eastern Kingdoms than the ones right here in Thelsamar!

1573|10cfc531.name: Gryth Thurden
1573|10cfc531.text: The Wildhammer dwarves might have fast steeds, but can those Aerie Peak gryphons stand the heat of The Great Forge?  I think not!

1681|d4740e3c.name: Brock Stoneseeker
1681|d4740e3c.text: The best miner has a firm grip on his pick, a stout heart in his chest, and thick, black dust in his hair.

2327|2957a3a0.name: Shaina Fuller
2327|2957a3a0.text: Oh, a fellow Physician. I would be glad to teach you anything that would aid your journeys.

2409|c5ceacbe.name: Felicia Maline
2409|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2455|6928abbf.name: Olivia Burnside
2455|6928abbf.text: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us ma'am?

2456|6928abbf.name: Newton Burnside
2456|6928abbf.text: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us ma'am?

2481|014b9d07.name: Bliztik
2481|014b9d07.text:
A customer all the way out here? What luck! This place was a goldmine of empty alchemy bottles. Kinda weird.

Don't worry, I washed 'em out.

249713|0c768ee1.name: Odd Child
249713|0c768ee1.text: Shhh! You'll give away my hiding spot!

253092|e0247c5d.name: Alba Fairmoon
253092|e0247c5d.text:
I am told the farms of Westfall once supplied a bounty of crops for Stormwind. But now, the soil is barren and most of the farmers have fled.

On behalf of Darnassus I would like to offer my aid in replenishing this land. Will you assist me?

258098|1605f087.name: Eldrun Stormbreaker
258098|1605f087.text: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

258113|1605f087.name: Ingrid Dunwald
258113|1605f087.text: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

264936|6ba63b30.name: Earthseer Farsen
264936|6ba63b30.text: On a clear day, you can even see Blackrock Mountain from here. It's both beautiful and terrifying at the same time.

265|94d9e780.name: Madame Eva
265|94d9e780.text: I have sensed your coming for quite some time, $N.  It was written in the pattern of the stars.

267683|b4b21be5.name: Red Mechanostrider
267683|b4b21be5.text:
<The tag on the mechanostrider reads:

Crimson-Blastdasher XL 300. Now with extra terrain grips and a sleek new color!>

268047|53fff4bc.name: Theramore Emissary
268047|53fff4bc.text: I am sorry, $c, but you are not experienced enough yet to enter Darkspear Islands.

268|f1060a41.name: Sirra Von'Indi
268|f1060a41.text: Greetings, $c! I have but one goal: the cataloging and recording of all knowledge related to the history of Duskwood and Darkshire. Perhaps you could help me in my endeavor?

3442|6812c5a7.name: Sputtervalve
3442|6812c5a7.text:
Interesting, interesting... I know of a druid that lives atop the hill above the Wailing Caverns, $N. She might be able to tell you more about this shard you have found.

Now, I must get back to work!

3442|ef9d74c5.name: Sputtervalve
3442|ef9d74c5.text: Director Riddlevox put me in charge of the Union's shredder development program. Few months on the job and I'm already in hot water! I could use your help, $N!

3446|36457281.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
3446|36457281.text:
Yes yes yes!  You're just the $r I'm looking for!

Sit!  We have much to discuss!!

352|035b100d.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|035b100d.text: Where is it ye would like to go lass? For just a few coin my Gryphons can get ye there faster than even the swiftest horse.

352|4946c28b.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|4946c28b.text: Where is it ye would like to go lad? For just a few coin my Gryphons can get ye there faster than even the swiftest horse.

352|c23f1156.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|c23f1156.text: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.

3691|3e6c050b.name: Raene Wolfrunner
3691|3e6c050b.text: I know these forests as if they were a part of me... But know that there is still much to be learned from them, and much danger still hidden.

381|50146e32.name: Dockmaster Baren
381|50146e32.text: Well met, $C.  If you're here for business, then get yourself a brew and we'll have ourselves a talk.

382|04802d87.name: Marshal Marris
382|04802d87.text: I don't have time to chat, citizen, but if you're willing to give us a hand against the orcs, then I'll find a use for you.

3885|d83258b9.name: Sentinel Velene Starstrike
3885|d83258b9.text:
Have you seen the befouled water elementals in our lake, $N? It is a sorry sight, but I do not know where they are coming from.

Your name has been mentioned in conversations past, perhaps you could help me with this problem.

The first thing we must learn is who is in control of these elementals.

392|9183bb21.name: Captain Grayson
392|9183bb21.text: Do not be alarmed, $r.  I have long since passed from this land but I intend no harm to your kind.  I have witnessed too much death in my time.  My only wish now is for peace.  Perhaps you can help my cause.

3963|c8a70fb5.name: Danlaar Nightstride
3963|c8a70fb5.text: What can I do for you my child?

4217|34f0a84a.name: Mathrengyl Bearwalker
4217|34f0a84a.text:
Welcome, my sister.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.

There are rumors of strife within the Cenarion Circle, but you should pay such loose talk no heed.  Our Arch $C, Fandral Staghelm, leads us and all of Teldrassil to glory!

4256|d1bed30c.name: Golnir Bouldertoe
4256|d1bed30c.text: If you ask me, there's no greater profession than a miner.  And if you ask me, there's no greater miner than a $r!

4262|90df76a3.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|90df76a3.text:
Ah, are you looking perhaps to change your markings, or prepare for a hunt? There is no better place.

You will find the barber in the Tradesman's Terrace, near the auction house.

4262|ce424d00.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|ce424d00.text: Of all the wondrous places within Darnassus, which would you have me direct you to?

4267|c5ceacbe.name: Daelyshia
4267|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

4320|0e051c59.name: Caelyb
4320|0e051c59.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

4407|c5ceacbe.name: Teloren
4407|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

5127|62ce6712.name: Fimble Finespindle
5127|62ce6712.text: Lots to do! Haven't been this busy since my cousin accidentally vaporized all the cloth and leather in Gnomeregan. My, it was drafty for a while! Ah, $N, those were the days....

523|d6469a91.name: Thor
523|d6469a91.text: Where are you going?  Well if you're looking to get there quickly, then look no further!

5504|e653c173.name: Sheldras Moontree
5504|e653c173.text:
Welcome, my sister.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.

There will be a time soon where the call of the Emerald Dream will take hold in you.  You will hibernate for many years and walk amongst the purest of forms.  It is there and then that your ultimate training will take place.

5519|3d4f7092.name: Billibub Cogspinner
5519|3d4f7092.text: If you insert tab A into slot B then of course it's going to go BOOM! Here, let me show you what I have and then you can ask Lilliam about how to put it together so it doesn't blow up.

5595|8f560eff.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|8f560eff.text: Which profession trainer would ye be looking for?

5595|ce6a7b9d.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|ce6a7b9d.text: What do ye need directions to?

633|b8d58f51.name: Elaine Carevin
633|b8d58f51.text: It's dark times that have come, $c... All too soon will we lose everything... When the Light will forsake all but those who truly walk under the Light.

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

656|eb6991e6.name: Wilder Thistlenettle
656|eb6991e6.text:
There were thieves everywhere! 

It was horrible.  The cave came down on us.  I think the mining company is all dead, including my brother, the Foreman.

6734|b63e4e81.name: Innkeeper Hearthstove
6734|b63e4e81.text: Fill yer tankard and pull up a chair. We've stories to tell and kegs to empty.

6738|41276936.name: Innkeeper Kimlya
6738|41276936.text: Your body looks worn and your spirit weary. Rest yourself beneath our roof and allow Elune to guide your dreams.

6790|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Trelayne
6790|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

8508|15b608c8.name: Gretta Ganter
8508|15b608c8.text: Lookin' to fish? Then you'll need the proper tools.

8931|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Heather
8931|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

931|c5ceacbe.name: Ariena Stormfeather
931|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1016-progress.name: Sentinel Velene Starstrike
1016-progress.text: Since you must destroy the bracers to kill the elementals, it will probably be difficult to find the specific ones that contain the information the divining scroll needs. You can trade bracers with others in order to obtain the ones you need, or perhaps you have the divined paper already?
1016-progress.title: Elemental Bracers

103-progress.name: Captain Grayson
103-progress.text: The flame will not burn for long without oil, $N.
103-progress.title: Keeper of the Flame

1035-progress.name: Pelturas Whitemoon
1035-progress.text: Did you face the Shadethicket Oracle, $N?  If so, then please hand me the fallen moonstone.  Relara has strength left for only a few more breaths!
1035-progress.title: Fallen Sky Lake

104-progress.name: Captain Grayson
104-progress.text:
Have you laid waste to the menace known as Old Murk-Eye yet?  He has been spotted roaming the coastline of Westfall.

Return to me when the foul beast is dead.
104-progress.title: The Coastal Menace

1054-progress.name: Raene Wolfrunner
1054-progress.text: The furbolgs' corruption has caused Ashenvale to become a fraction of its former glory.
1054-progress.title: Culling the Threat

127-progress.name: Dockmaster Baren
127-progress.text: You have some sunfish for me, eh?
127-progress.title: Selling Fish

132-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
132-progress.text: Good to see you back, $N.  What did Wiley have to say for himself?
132-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

1338-progress.name: Furen Longbeard
1338-progress.text:
A letter from the dwarven lands?  I wonder who would call from so far to the north...

Please, let me see the order.
1338-progress.title: Stormpike's Order

135-progress.name: Master Mathias Shaw
135-progress.text: What business do you have with me?  I am a very busy man. . .
135-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

141-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
141-progress.text: Did Master Shaw shed any light on things?
141-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

142-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
142-progress.text: $N, were you able to gather any information?  Did you locate the messenger?
142-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

149-progress.name: Blind Mary
149-progress.text:
<Sob> Oh please, don't look at me!  I tore out these eyes with my own hands, but I can still feel your gaze!

I'm hideous!  Hideous!  Please, look away!!
149-progress.title: Ghost Hair Thread

150-progress.name: Dockmaster Baren
150-progress.text: Do you have those fins?  Hurry, we need those murlocs driven from the lake!
150-progress.title: Murloc Poachers

154-progress.name: Madame Eva
154-progress.text: I sense that you have seen Blind Mary.  You have my Comb...?
154-progress.title: Return the Comb

164-progress.name: Sven Yorgen
164-progress.text: You look a sturdy type, $c. Have you come to join our fight?
164-progress.title: Deliveries to Sven

166-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
166-progress.text: How goes the hunt for Edwin VanCleef?
166-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

174-progress.name: Viktori Prism'Antras
174-progress.text: Have you found a skilled engineer to create a bronze tube yet?
174-progress.title: Look to the Stars

177-progress.name: Viktori Prism'Antras
177-progress.text: I showed Cog the beginnings of our star-viewing machine.  He was impressed.  Did you happen to find a reflective device?
177-progress.title: Look to the Stars

18-progress.name: Deputy Willem
18-progress.text: Have you gathered those bandanas for me yet?
18-progress.title: Brotherhood of Thieves

20-progress.name: Marshal Marris
20-progress.text: Have you been slaying orcs, $N?  If so, then show me...
20-progress.title: Blackrock Menace

2040-progress.name: Shoni the Shilent
2040-progress.text: Have you found the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket, $N?
2040-progress.title: Underground Assault

214-progress.name: Scout Riell
214-progress.text: Have you been reclaiming our land from the Defias gang?  If so show me 10 Red Silk Bandanas as proof.
214-progress.title: Red Silk Bandanas

288-progress.name: First Mate Fitzsimmons
288-progress.text: Oh, I'm so very thirsty! Won't you buy a drink for this poor, pathetic fool?
288-progress.title: The Third Fleet

291-progress.name: Senator Barin Redstone
291-progress.text: Hmm... it would seem that my guards are becoming less discriminatory with petitioners. Well, what do you want? Make it quick.
291-progress.title: The Reports

296-progress.name: Ormer Ironbraid
296-progress.text: Is Sarltooth dead? Have you redeemed the memory of the fallen?
296-progress.title: Ormer's Revenge

308-progress.name: Jarven Thunderbrew
308-progress.text: Hmph! There is all this booze down here, but I have strict orders not to touch it. If only I could get a taste of some of our Thunder Ale...that would sharpen my wits, no lying!
308-progress.title: Distracting Jarven

310-progress.name: Unknown
310-progress.text: The date on this barrel shows that it'll soon be tapped.
310-progress.title: Bitter Rivals

312-progress.name: Tundra MacGrann
312-progress.text: Were you able to get into my meat locker, $N?
312-progress.title: Tundra MacGrann's Stolen Stash

313-progress.name: Pilot Stonegear
313-progress.text: Hey, $N.  Been to the Grizzled Den yet?  Those Wendigos can be fierce.
313-progress.title: The Grizzled Den

314-progress.name: Rudra Amberstill
314-progress.text: Vagash still terrorizes the herd!  Please help us by killing the wretched beast.
314-progress.title: Protecting the Herd

315-progress.name: Rejold Barleybrew
315-progress.text: Do you have that shimmerweed?  I almost have a batch of stout ready to brew, and I want to try throwing the weed in with this mixture.
315-progress.title: The Perfect Stout

317-progress.name: Pilot Bellowfiz
317-progress.text: Preparations are going well.  How goes your hunting?
317-progress.title: Stocking Jetsteam

33-progress.name: Eagan Peltskinner
33-progress.text: Hey $N.  I'm getting hungry...did you get that tough wolf meat?
33-progress.title: Wolves Across the Border

373-progress.name: Baros Alexston
373-progress.text: Yes? Is there something I can help you with?
373-progress.title: The Unsent Letter

384-progress.name: Ragnar Thunderbrew
384-progress.text: I'm going to need six crag boar ribs and a mug of Rhapsody Malt, $N.
384-progress.title: Beer Basted Boar Ribs

3905-progress.name: Brother Neals
3905-progress.text: You look to be in fine spirits!  Come!  Have a seat, and have a drink!
3905-progress.title: Grape Manifest

400-progress.name: Beldin Steelgrill
400-progress.text:
Hm?  You look a little young to be a siege engine pilot.  But no matter...do you need something fixed?

Well take a number and get comfortable.  I'm working on a couple engines right now and won't have time for another job for at least a few days.

Or, were you here for something else...?
400-progress.title: Tools for Steelgrill

413-progress.name: Mountaineer Barleybrew
413-progress.text:
Hello, $C!  And what business takes you all the way out here?

Something exciting, I hope.  I haven't been in a good fight in days, and this barrel of ale is almost dry...
413-progress.title: Shimmer Stout

417-progress.name: Pilot Hammerfoot
417-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Do you have word of my friend Hildelve?
417-progress.title: A Pilot's Revenge

418-progress.name: Vidra Hearthstove
418-progress.text: I'm all ready to start cooking, do you have the ingredients for me?
418-progress.title: Thelsamar Blood Sausages

5541-progress.name: Hegnar Rumbleshot
5541-progress.text: I hope you're not here for ammo, because I'm almost out!
5541-progress.title: Ammo for Rumbleshot

6-progress.name: Deputy Willem
6-progress.text: Did you find Garrick's shack?  Are we finally free of that villain?
6-progress.title: Bounty on Garrick Padfoot

6387-progress.name: Thorgrum Borrelson
6387-progress.text: Have you had your fill of Thelsamar so soon?  Are you ready to leave for another city?
6387-progress.title: Honor Students

6388-progress.name: Gryth Thurden
6388-progress.text: You look like you have somewhere to go.  Need one of my gryphons?
6388-progress.title: Gryth Thurden

6391-progress.name: Golnir Bouldertoe
6391-progress.text: What can I do for you, sir?
6391-progress.title: Ride to Ironforge

6661-progress.name: Monty
6661-progress.text: Yarrr... Swabby, what be takin' ye so long?
6661-progress.title: Deeprun Rat Roundup

6662-progress.name: Nipsy
6662-progress.text:
<Nipsy puts his index finger through one of the air holes in the carton.>

Alive and kicking... and just in time!
6662-progress.title: Me Brother, Nipsy

68-progress.name: Clerk Daltry
68-progress.text: Ah, I remember you.  You're the one who was asking about that Stalvan fellow.  Did you ever find what you were looking for?
68-progress.title: The Legend of Stalvan

6981-progress.name: Falla Sagewind
6981-progress.text: Hello, $r. What can I do for you?
6981-progress.title: The Glowing Shard

90-progress.name: Chef Grual
90-progress.text: Were you able to find 10 Lean Wolf Flanks yet?
90-progress.title: Seasoned Wolf Kabobs

91741-progress.name: Brother Paxton
91741-progress.text: What's that you got there? It looks like one of my books.
91741-progress.title: Nibbled-On Book

91743-progress.name: Brother Paxton
91743-progress.text: Have you rescued my books yet, $N?!
91743-progress.title: Rascally Rodents

91752-progress.name: Marshal McBride
91752-progress.text: Have you retrieved those stolen books yet?
91752-progress.title: The Big Picture

93-progress.name: Chef Grual
93-progress.text: Hail, $N.  Did you get those Gooey Spider Legs yet?
93-progress.title: Dusky Crab Cakes

94914-complete.name: Dendrite Starblaze
94914-complete.text: Ah I see that you have already mastered the form of the Bear. Good, good. You are well on your way, young $c.
94914-complete.title: Moonglade

95214-progress.name: Quarrymaster Thesten
95214-progress.text: I hope you've got good news for me?
95214-progress.title: Stolen Blasting Powder

96395-accept.name: Unknown
96395-accept.text:
The... Thane... my mighty... Thane... he... needs to... rest.

Please... help him... help him... rest...

Consumed... by... ancient... grudge... No... rest...
96395-accept.title: An Ancient Grudge

96395-complete.name: Unknown
96395-complete.text:
